interaction_history.overview: Adventurer/surgeon/rock musician Buckaroo Banzai and his band of men, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, take on evil alien invaders from the 8th dimension.
interaction_history.title: Adventures of Buckaroo Bonzai Across the 8th Dimension, The

interaction_history.overview: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.
interaction_history.title: Godfather, The

interaction_history.overview: A man with a low IQ has accomplished great things in his life and been present during significant historic events - in each case, far exceeding what anyone imagined he could do. Yet, despite all the things he has attained, his one true love eludes him. 'Forrest Gump' is the story of a man who rose above his challenges, and who proved that determination, courage, and love are more important than ability.
interaction_history.title: Forrest Gump

interaction_history.overview: Danny is obsessed with a fictional movie character action hero Jack Slater. When a magical ticket transports him into Jack's latest adventure, Danny finds himself in a world where movie magic and reality collide. Now it's up to Danny to save the life of his hero and new friend.
interaction_history.title: Last Action Hero

interaction_history.overview: Having been hopelessly repressed and facing eventual certain death at the British chicken farm where they are held, Rocky the american rooster and Ginger the chicken decide to rebel against the evil Mr. and Mrs. Tweedy, the farm's owners. Rocky and Ginger lead their fellow chickens in a great escape from the murderous farmers and their farm of doom.
interaction_history.title: Chicken Run

interaction_history.overview: A burger-loving hit man, his philosophical partner, a drug-addled gangster's moll and a washed-up boxer converge in this sprawling, comedic crime caper. Their adventures unfurl in three stories that ingeniously trip back and forth in time.
interaction_history.title: Pulp Fiction

interaction_history.overview: Greg Focker is ready to marry his girlfriend, Pam, but before he pops the question, he must win over her formidable father, humorless former CIA agent Jack Byrnes, at the wedding of Pam's sister. As Greg bends over backward to make a good impression, his visit to the Byrnes home turns into a hilarious series of disasters, and everything that can go wrong does, all under Jack's critical, hawklike gaze.
interaction_history.title: Meet the Parents

interaction_history.overview: Dangerous Liaisons is the film based on the novel of the same name by Choderlos de Laclos set in 18th century France. Marquise de Merteuil’s asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned in this love triangle drama.
interaction_history.title: Dangerous Liaisons

interaction_history.overview: When Dr. Henry Jones Sr. suddenly goes missing while pursuing the Holy Grail, eminent archaeologist Indiana must team up with Marcus Brody, Sallah and Elsa Schneider to follow in his father's footsteps and stop the Nazis from recovering the power of eternal life.
interaction_history.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

interaction_history.overview: With the help of a talking freeway billboard, a "wacky weatherman" tries to win the heart of an English newspaper reporter, who is struggling to make sense of the strange world of early-90s Los Angeles.
interaction_history.title: L.A. Story

unique_tastes.summary: Unique tastes: Strong preference for Comedy (Multiple high ratings for comedies across various sub-genres.); Appreciation for Drama (Consistently high ratings for dramatic films, indicating a strong affinity for the genre.); Enjoyment of Action and Adventure (High ratings for action and adventure films suggest a liking for thrilling narratives.); Interest in Romantic elements (Several high-rated films incorporate romance, showing a preference for romantic storylines.); Favoring films with complex narratives (High ratings for films with intricate plots and character development.). Liked patterns: High ratings for films that blend Comedy with other genres, Consistent appreciation for films that feature strong character arcs, Preference for films that include elements of Drama alongside Comedy. Disliked patterns: Dislike for Action comedies that do not resonate, Negative response to films with weak comedic elements.
